description: Prominent Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty Wednesday to conspiracy to collude with foreign forces to endanger national security under a Beijing-imposed law that has effectively stifled the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.
title: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in 2nd national security case

description: Blue Rodeo fan Patti McKague tells The National about the moment she and 16,000 fans joined the band in belting out “in the middle of Lake Ontario” during their performance of the song Hasn't Hit Me Yet in Toronto.
title: 16,000 fans belt out Lake Ontario lyric at Blue Rodeo concert | The Moment

description: Tyler Robinson, the man accused of fatally shooting prominent U.S. conservative activist Charlie Kirk on ‌a Utah college campus last year, pleaded not guilty on Tuesday to a murder charge that a judge ruled could carry the death penalty.
title: Accused in Charlie Kirk shooting pleads not guilty to murder charge that could carry death penalty

author: Jack Farrell
description: Premier Danielle Smith defended her upcoming personal trip to the United States when asked if it was sending the wrong message amid an active trade war with Canada's southern neighbours.
title: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says Tennessee trip isn't sending wrong message amid trade war

author: Hanna Lee
description: More than 170 Jewish members of the entertainment industry, including Hannah Einbinder, Joel Coen and Canadian filmmaker Emma Seligman, have signed an open letter defending American actor Mark Ruffalo from what the letter calls an "outrageous smear campaign."
title: Hannah Einbinder, Emma Seligman and others sign letter challenging antisemitism claims against Mark Ruffalo

author: Joel Dryden

title: Two sides in Alberta separation debate  entrenched, with majority wanting to remain in Canada: poll

author: Yasmine Hassan
description: Four people were killed in a Gaza City displacement camp Tuesday in a raid Israel's defence minister said was to locate a senior Hamas official.
title: In search for senior Hamas operative, Israeli raid on Gaza City camp kills 3 children

description: Scientists at a little-known federal agency in Ottawa reveal the forensic tools that helped crack the largest art fraud case in history. For decades, the forgery ring produced thousands of fake paintings attributed to famed Anishinaabe artist Norval Morrisseau.
title: How scientists confirmed the 'paint by numbers' Norval Morrisseau fraud ring

author: Andrew Jeffrey
description: The RCMP announced on Tuesday they had laid charges against Craig Michael Thompson, 49, for allegedly misappropriating investor funds from more than 1,000 victims via his company, Black Box Management.
title: RCMP charge Calgary man for allegedly running $164M Ponzi scheme

author: Yumna Iftikhar
description: Fort Good Hope, N.W.T., resident Chloe Dixon was diagnosed with a soft-tissue sarcoma in the summer of last year. While treatment for cancers like hers can impact a person's fertility, a relatively new procedure in Canada is giving Chloe the choice of having children in the future.
title: Fertility program offers future choices for 12-year-old N.W.T. cancer patient

description: The German government is blaming Russia for an attempted attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport last month using a drone laden with explosives, and announced it would shut down a Russian consulate, among other measures against Moscow.
title: Russia attempted attack at airport last month using explosive-laden drone, Germany says

author: Jonathan Ore
description: As video games become an increasingly digital-first hobby, the people keeping the Atari name alive are going back to their roots, by offering new versions of their 1980s classics.

description: Canada has an infanticide provision in the Criminal Code that applies exclusively to a mother who kills her newly born child while her mind is "disturbed."
